answer.justification: Only output-level data is available. Median first divergence is 10 and edit distance is 0.531, both inside the quantized range (10-17 and 0.52-0.57). The exact-match rate of 0.031 is also within the quantized range. Base is ruled out because the replies differ. System-prompted is ruled out because divergence does not start at token 0, edit distance is far below 0.79-0.82, and there are no stage directions. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative: its median divergence of 5.5-8 is lower than the observed 10, and its edit distance of 0.56-0.65 is higher than the observed 0.531.
